credits.title: Splinters
credits.overview: After returning to his childhood home for his mother’s wake, a young man confronts the lasting impact of his traumatic upbringing.

credits.title: Roots
credits.overview: When an ancestry test leaves Andre, a Black teenager adopted into a white family, questioning his place among those he loves most, he turns to his older brother for help. Together, they devise an unlikely plan to convince their parents that he is their biological son.

credits.title: Keith
credits.overview: Kate has been running her child modelling agency for 25 years and prides herself on being unshakeable. But when interview day hits, Kate and her assistant Jeffrey are thrown into a parade of hopeful parents, and unpredictable children.

credits.title: Faceless
credits.overview: Experience three parallel lives of an Indigenous man in Naarm (Melbourne) – in each instance, we ponder if he will always be made to feel like an outsider in his own land.

credits.title: The Organist
credits.overview: When an embittered vital organ broker meets a karmically challenged universal donor, the pair scheme to ethically distribute organs to those in need and escape the maw of a ruthless HR department.

credits.title: Inn of the Damned
credits.overview: In the working-class suburbs of Melbourne, three friends are in the process of putting together the ultimate rock band; INN OF THE DAMNED. credits.title: Someone Else
credits.overview: Katie (Shamita Sivabalan) is a young, confidently queer woman. After finding herself attracted to a man for the first time in her life, she must decide whether the complicated nature of the relationship is worth pursuing.
